name: 02140 · Cambridge, MA
findings: ZIP 02140 (Cambridge) has 141 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02140 (Cambridge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02140 (Cambridge) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
